name: SLÄKT storage bed, desk in the window corner with BESTÅ storage above, reading corner by the step (fewest pieces)
notes:
Alternative, re-checked 2026-10-23: the SLÄKT storage bed, fewest pieces. Two changes: the BESTÅ unit on the empty wall above the desk (F-63), and the reading corner moved out of the slot in front of the heater to the step corner, facing the room. 14 placed, 9 extras.
bed-1 SLÄKT storage bed, head on the top wall, long side on the left wall, flush: its 2 drawers (33 lb each) and shelf open on the room side and replace the dresser and the TROFAST. F-32/F-34 27.25" clear at the head end to the desk, 41" to the chair and more below; F-33 bedding 71.5" from the heater face.
shelf-1 LACK wall shelf on the top wall beside the bed's head, about 10" above the mattress: the bedside table without legs, so the drawers open freely; 6.5 lb max, anchored (IKEA).
desk-1 FLISAT on the top wall in the window corner: F-33 right end 6" from the heater face; F-35 30" chair zone clear behind it, the chair 19.5" from the heater, not backed against a heater wall. chair-1 SUNDVIK at the desk ("Last chance").
cabinet-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, 47 1/4x16 1/2x15" (top, new): top wall above the desk, x 58.75-106, its right end 6" short of the heater face (F-33): closed storage hung above her reach for markers, paint, glue and rotation toys a parent hands down (F-63): solid LAPPVIKEN doors (no glass, F-21), hung on 2 BESTÅ suspension rails screwed into studs (extras), underside about 54" up. The canvas art moves to the left wall.
books-1 FLISAT book display as the reading corner by the step, rot 180, x 83.75-103, y 83.5-94.5, covers facing the room: its back on the closet doors' swing line without entering it, the 24" in front of the closet clear (F-31); its end 9" from the heater face (F-33). The SKOGSDUVA floor cushions (extras) go on the rug in front of it. Flag: assumed-position:closet.
bins-1, bins-2 DRÖNA toy boxes at the bed's foot (turned, 15 x 13"), 0.5" short of the door's swing (F-31). Flag: assumed-position:door.
rug-1 VALLABY rot 90, x 46-98, y 43-82: the reading and play floor, 14" from the heater face (F-33); its left 18.5" lies inside the drawers' 24" reach, flat, and the drawers' clearance over a rug is not on IKEA's page.
canopy-1 LÖVA over the bed's head, mounted out of reach (IKEA). lamp-1 UPPLYST on the left wall over the bed, cord fastened. nightlight-1 TÖVÄDER on the LACK shelf; plant-1 FEJKA (artificial) on the desk; art-1 BLODFLÄDER (canvas, no glass, F-21) on the left wall above the toy boxes, 1.5" clear of the open door.
Maddie is 4 (F-21): every piece within her reach is under 27" or anchored; no glass anywhere; no loft or bunk.
Walkways (F-30): door to room 48.75" between the DRÖNA boxes and the book display; bed to desk 41".
Extras: ÅSVANG in the frame (SLÄKT's mattress is 38 1/4 x 74 3/8") with the DVALA fitted sheet (up to 10"), SMÅSPORRE insert, BARNDRÖM cover, low pillow, SKOGSDUVA cushions x2 as the reading corner's floor seats, BENGTA panel (cut to clear the heater, F-33) on the HUGAD rod (assumed-position:window), BESTÅ suspension rails x2. Not placed: nothing.
Total $1,183.30: placed $885.87 + extras $297.43; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed.
